subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept this grouped set of action revisions after exact-head gates and direct upstream review, or split the credential-, Codex-, and release-sensitive pins into separately reviewed updates?
rationale: The patch is mechanically clean, but it replaces executable supply-chain components that handle secrets and publication authority; repository policy and the protected `security` label reserve that acceptance decision for a human owner.

options.title: Gate and approve bundle
options.body: Rebase, inspect the upstream action changes—especially Codex, token minting, and Docker publication—and merge only after the exact-head workflow gates complete.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate Codex, GitHub App token, CodeQL, and Docker publication pins so each trust boundary can be reviewed and rolled back independently.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Keep the existing pins until maintainers can validate the scheduled and release-only paths that ordinary PR CI does not exercise.

recommendation.title: Gate and approve bundle
recommendation.body: Rebase, inspect the upstream action changes—especially Codex, token minting, and Docker publication—and merge only after the exact-head workflow gates complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans both general action modernization and the central docs-agent and Docker release workflows.
